items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Was Red older or younger than you? Oh, he was just around my age.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Because Happy was a red boy. And so they ate the change and said, who you talking about, black Happy or red?
Was Red older or younger than you?
Oh, he was just around my age.
